prototype_notice: Procedural prototype, not finished anime; abstract ridges, one silhouetted traveler, moon and sparse particles only.

scenes.motif: Abstract moonlit ridges in layered blue-gray; one small stationary silhouetted traveler below center, sparse particles as faint traces. Desaturated charcoal and steel tones with a dim pearl moon convey tired stillness and isolation.
scenes.camera: Wide landscape with broad negative space above the small traveler and the moon offset from the figure; restrained slow lateral drift, traveler stationary.

scenes.motif: Same abstract ridges and stationary traveler suffused with dim faded amber, suggesting an indistinct recollection held within the blue-gray landscape; abstract particles only, no literal memory imagery.
scenes.camera: Slightly closer framing with a gentle inward move; traveler remains small and grounded, moon held as a stable anchor.

scenes.motif: Recollection withdraws into slate and muted indigo ridges with only a faint trace of amber in the glow; particles thinned, traveler held in spacious quiet as weariness returns.
scenes.camera: Return toward the opening spacious wide framing at the same traveler position; camera settles with minimal movement.

scenes.motif: Weaker echo of recollection: faint dusty amber returns within charcoal and blue ridges, abstract particles only, no dramatic reveal; traveler remains isolated and stationary in generous darkness.
scenes.camera: Wide landscape preserving generous negative space around the isolated traveler; restrained slow drift, no abrupt change.

scenes.motif: Warmth recedes into muted blue-gray with a residual warm tint in moon and glow; abstract ridges and small traveler persist quietly beneath the moon, particles visually quieter, ending in subdued visibility without resolution.
scenes.camera: Balanced wide view with the small traveler beneath the moon and readable ridge contours; movement settles to near stillness.
